_comment: Reviewed selection for the head-and-neck exhibit (AI-assisted visual and quantitative review in 3D Slicer; not a clinical validation). `keep` is ordered by overlap priority: when two different models claim a voxel, the earlier entry keeps it.

parameters.thin_sheet_rule: soft-tissue sheets thinner than 3 mm (2 published voxels) with < 50 HU contrast to their surroundings are excluded
parameters.fov_rule: structures cut by a lateral/posterior/top image border are excluded unless the retained part is the anatomically relevant medial portion (clavicles, subclavian arteries, left first rib, left levator scapulae); structures running through the lower scan boundary are kept and flagged

excluded.auditory_canal_left: external ear canal: outside the airway/neck exhibit; left one also touches the lateral image border
excluded.auditory_canal_right: external ear canal: outside the airway/neck exhibit
excluded.lung_lower_lobe_left: cut by the scan's field of view: only a 44 mL wedge above the lower scan boundary
excluded.lung_lower_lobe_right: cut by the scan's field of view: only a 43 mL wedge above the lower scan boundary
excluded.lung_upper_lobe_left: cut by the scan's field of view: lateral image border (12,407 border voxels = 70 cm2 cut face) and lower scan boundary; a flat-cut apex would mislead
excluded.lung_upper_lobe_right: cut by the scan's field of view: lateral image border (9,480 border voxels = 53 cm2 cut face) and lower scan boundary; a flat-cut apex would mislead
excluded.nasal_cavity_left: sheet-like mask 1-2 published voxels wide that includes turbinate mucosa (mean -451 HU); its anterior third lies in the publisher-blurred facial zone; not trustworthy at 1.5 mm
excluded.sinus_frontal: above the exhibit boundary (forehead); touches the top image border
excluded.sinus_maxillary: mid-face air cavity outside the airway/neck scope; would be cut by the exhibit's upper boundary
excluded.costal_cartilages: cut by the scan's field of view: four disconnected fragments of the first and second costal cartilages
excluded.rib_left_2: cut by the scan's field of view: two fragments (largest 73 %), lateral image border
excluded.rib_right_2: cut by the scan's field of view: two fragments (largest 76 %), lateral image border
excluded.rib_left_3: cut by the scan's field of view: 3 mL posterior stub at the lateral image border
excluded.rib_left_4: cut by the scan's field of view: posterior stub at the lateral image border
excluded.rib_left_5: cut by the scan's field of view: posterior stub at the lateral image border
excluded.rib_left_6: cut by the scan's field of view: posterior stub at the lateral image border
excluded.rib_right_3: cut by the scan's field of view: posterior stub at the lateral image border
excluded.rib_right_4: cut by the scan's field of view: posterior stub at the lateral image border
excluded.rib_right_5: cut by the scan's field of view: posterior stub at the lateral and posterior image borders
excluded.rib_right_6: cut by the scan's field of view: stub at the posterior border and lower scan boundary
excluded.scapula_right: cut by the scan's field of view: 2.4 mL sliver at the lateral image border (Dice 0.65 against the publisher label)
excluded.skull [task total]: task `total` skull includes the mandible and teeth (97 % of the mandible mask, 100 % of both teeth masks lie inside it); replaced by the craniofacial_structures skull, which is separate from the mandible
excluded.styloid_process_left: 0.20 mL, 2-3 published voxels across: too small to be trustworthy at 1.5 mm; lies inside the skull mask
excluded.styloid_process_right: 0.17 mL, 2-3 published voxels across: too small to be trustworthy at 1.5 mm; lies inside the skull mask
excluded.vertebrae_T6: cut by the scan's field of view: cut through the vertebral body by the lower scan boundary (1,837 border voxels)
excluded.vertebrae_T7: 44-voxel fragment at the lower scan boundary
excluded.zygomatic_arch_left: 0.30 mL, two fragments; duplicates part of the skull mask; facial skeleton outside the exhibit; lies in the publisher-blurred cheek zone
excluded.zygomatic_arch_right: 0.22 mL, three fragments; duplicates part of the skull mask; facial skeleton outside the exhibit; lies in the publisher-blurred cheek zone
excluded.parotid_gland_left: cut by the scan's field of view: lateral image border (991 border voxels = 5.6 cm2 cut face)
excluded.parotid_gland_right: mask is complete, but the lateral-face gland is outside the airway/neck scope and its left counterpart is cut by the field of view, so the pair cannot be shown
excluded.autochthon_left: cut by the scan's field of view: posterior image border (2,120 border voxels = 11.9 cm2 cut face) and lower scan boundary
excluded.autochthon_right: cut by the scan's field of view: posterior image border (2,142 border voxels = 12.0 cm2 cut face) and lower scan boundary
excluded.digastric_left: anterior belly only (1.0 mL) lying in the publisher-blurred submental zone; image content there is not original
excluded.digastric_right: anterior belly only (1.2 mL) lying in the publisher-blurred submental zone; image content there is not original
excluded.inferior_pharyngeal_constrictor: pharyngeal-wall sheet about 2.7 mm thick (< 2 published voxels) with no HU contrast against the prevertebral muscles (-6 HU); position is the model's prior, not image evidence
excluded.middle_pharyngeal_constrictor: pharyngeal-wall sheet about 2.4 mm thick (< 2 published voxels); not resolvable at 1.5 mm
excluded.superior_pharyngeal_constrictor: pharyngeal-wall sheet about 2.1 mm thick (< 2 published voxels); not resolvable at 1.5 mm
excluded.platysma_left: sheet about 1.9 mm thick (about 1 published voxel), ragged partial coverage, partly in the publisher-blurred zone
excluded.platysma_right: sheet about 1.9 mm thick (about 1 published voxel), ragged partial coverage, partly in the publisher-blurred zone
excluded.posterior_scalene_left: small (2.2 mL) and asymmetric: left/right volume ratio 2.8; border with the middle scalene and levator scapulae not resolvable
excluded.posterior_scalene_right: small (0.8 mL) and asymmetric: left/right volume ratio 2.8; border with the middle scalene and levator scapulae not resolvable
excluded.temporalis_left: cut by the scan's field of view: lateral and top image borders; lies above the exhibit boundary
excluded.temporalis_right: cut by the scan's field of view: lateral and top image borders; lies above the exhibit boundary
excluded.thyrohyoid_left: strap about 2.2 mm thick (< 2 published voxels) with no HU contrast against its surroundings (-14 HU)
excluded.thyrohyoid_right: strap about 2.2 mm thick (< 2 published voxels) with no HU contrast against its surroundings (-12 HU)
excluded.trapezius_left: cut by the scan's field of view: lateral and posterior image borders (6,453 border voxels = 36 cm2 cut face)
excluded.trapezius_right: cut by the scan's field of view: lateral and posterior image borders (8,416 border voxels = 47 cm2 cut face)
excluded.brain: outside the exhibit (cut by the top image border)
excluded.eye_left: orbit: outside the exhibit; lies in the publisher-blurred facial zone
excluded.eye_right: orbit: outside the exhibit; lies in the publisher-blurred facial zone
excluded.eye_lens_right: orbit: outside the exhibit (0.03 mL; the left lens mask was empty)
excluded.head: outer surface of the whole head (skin). Never exported: privacy
excluded.heart: cut by the scan's field of view: only the top 26 mm above the lower scan boundary
